public_rationale: OpenAI's October 28, 2025 disclosure says the nonprofit retained control after the restructuring [e1]. The Financial Times report of June 15, 2026 cites an unnamed person linking a roughly $30 billion charge to rising values of investor rights in 2025 [e2]. That report does not reconcile this figure with the claimed $41.55 billion loss on convertible interests and warrant liability, or establish whether restructuring caused that specified loss [e2]. The causal claim remains unresolved [e1, e2].
limitations: The evidence does not reconcile periodic revaluation, any restructuring-triggered charge, warrant changes, and allocations to noncontrolling interests.
The roughly $30 billion figure has an unspecified attribution scope and cannot establish a numerical contradiction.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's 2025 conversion to a for-profit entity led to a $41.55 billion loss from changes in fair value of convertible interests and warrant liability.

statement.excerpt: Please note that 2025 was the year that OpenAI converted from a non-profit to a for-profit entity, leading to a $41.55 billion loss due to changes in fair value of convertible interests and warrant liability.
statement.document_title: Exclusive: OpenAI Losses Increased Nearly 8X in 2025, With Spending Hitting $34 Billion

from_speaker: converted from a non-profit to a for-profit entity
changes in fair value of convertible interests and warrant liability
our_interpretation: Read the conversion reference as the 2025 restructuring of OpenAI's business. Separately check the accuracy of the nonprofit description.
The claim requires evidence that the restructuring caused the specified charge. A charge occurring in the same year is insufficient.
The surrounding discussion attributes these figures to OpenAI's financial statements, so the claimed basis is company_reported.
criteria.support_condition: Financial statements or independently verified reporting establish a 2025 loss rounding to $41.55 billion on the specified instruments and explain how the restructuring caused that loss.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish a materially different charge or show that the specified loss arose from a different cause, rather than the restructuring.
